public_observation.fixture: one in-memory fake Write records a single write attempt with exact bytes and a flush token; configured modes are success, BrokenPipe on write, and TimedOut on flush

classifier.Preserved: all public predicates of the case are decidable and true
classifier.Violated: at least one public predicate is decidable and false, with the declared public witness
classifier.Unknown: the case is explicitly opaque or a required public fact is absent or ambiguous
classifier.fail_closed: Unknown is never promoted to Preserved and never rejects a mutant; any unexpected Unknown blocks seal and PASS
classifier.binding_rule: classification uses only frozen source structure and the canonical in-memory Write observations; no real stderr, terminal, process or watcher is executed

positive_cases.predicate: write_watch_block is private, has the frozen &mut impl Write plus &str signature, returns io::Result<()> and does not capture stderr
success invokes Write::write_all exactly once with the complete byte sequence including UTF-8, NUL and embedded LF, without prefix, suffix or transformation
success event log equals [write(exact-block-bytes),flush], with one write_all, one flush and Ok
a BrokenPipe write failure returns BrokenPipe after one write attempt and before any flush
a TimedOut flush failure occurs after one integral successful write, records one flush and returns TimedOut
fresh writers under repetition and normal/reverse corpus order retain identical bytes, event logs, cardinalities, ErrorKinds, classifications and witnesses
emit_watch_block is private, obtains stderr, holds one mutable lock through exactly one write_watch_block delegation and passes the original block unchanged
emit_watch_block treats any helper Err as explicit failure through expect, unwrap or an equivalent non-silent boundary
the P1365 Compiling block is passed unchanged to emit_watch_block exactly once before run_compile_observed
the terminal P1366 callback block is passed unchanged to emit_watch_block exactly once before diagnostics
productive inventory contains exactly two emit_watch_block status callsites and zero retained eprint status callsites
drain_to_stderr, drain_to_stderr_with_primary, warnings, errors, HTML warning and operational messages have zero calls to either P1367 helper
exactly one in-process test function exercises success, write failure and flush failure only through an in-memory fake writer
productive delta is confined to two private helpers and two status callsite migrations in main.rs; test and lineage are the only other authorized delta
public API, status bytes, P1366 diagnostic order, polling, staging, publish, abandon, wait, eviction and non-watch commands remain unchanged

determinism_protocol.required: same classification, reason code and public witness under fresh repetition and reverse order
determinism_protocol.state_rule: classifier is a pure function of frozen source and bounded in-memory observation fields; no cache, clock, filesystem, environment, stderr, process or evaluation-order dependence

calibration_budget.stop_rule: two consecutive revisions without a changed classification vector or new witness require redesign; mutation score 1.0 ends calibration

claim_limit: This suite discriminates only the frozen P1367 integral-write, explicit-flush, error-propagation and two-status routing fragment; it does not attest isolation or general vanila parity.
